new.statement: Games not updated for more than 6 weeks stay on Most Popular for fewer days

The throw-and-collect template (throw food or a friend, lure rarer creatures, pen income, pull-up training) is the successor to the steal/egg wave: it keeps like ratios of 92 to 99% and one clone, Throw Food For Animals, already leads Most Popular
new.rationale: Today Throw a Friend for Monsters (97% likes, Top Trending #43), Throw Food For Clowns (92%), Throw Food for Chiikawas (98%, Up-and-Coming #86) and Throw Brains For Zombies (99%, #87) all chart, and Throw Food For Animals is among the best on Most Popular at 70 days. Confirm if the clones keep their ranks beyond week 5 instead of falling like the steal clones; refute if they fade at the same age.

new.statement: Physics sandboxes flood Up-and-Coming (15% of titles say Ragdoll, 20 profiled) but fail to convert: they climb Top Trending slower and earn less per player on Top Earning
new.rationale: Ragdoll title keyword r=-0.63 on Top Trending and -0.66 on Top Earning, sandbox loop median Up-and-Coming percentile 52 but Top Earning percentile 21. Confirm if the ragdoll cohort keeps falling off after week 3 across the next weeks; refute if any ragdoll game reaches Most Popular.

new.statement: Licensed-character +1 clones (Sonic, Naruto, Solo Leveling arise-shadow, Stickman) enter Up-and-Coming in the bottom half and slide within a month
new.rationale: Today they sit at Up-and-Coming #32, #51, #69 and #72, and +1 Arise a Shadow fell 22 places. Confirm if their positions keep falling week over week; refute if a new IP skin reaches the top 20.

new.statement: Platform-run events (The Great Build) take Up-and-Coming #1, Top Trending #1 and Most Popular #16 within three days and leave when the event ends
new.rationale: The Great Build is a Roblox Presents event running Nov 25-30 with free hourly blocks and no monetization. Confirm if it drops off the charts after Nov 30; refute if it stays.

new.statement: An hourglass update-countdown icon (24 HOURS, 21 HOURS, NOW) is common on trending young games
new.rationale: 8 of today's 60 profiled games use one (Cast For Fish, Wake Up An Animal, Throw a Friend for Monsters, Steal with Spider Arms, Find The Anomaly, BMX Life, Realistic Plane Crashing, +1 Arise a Shadow), nearly all on Top Trending or Up-and-Coming. Need the share among games without it and its link to momentum before raising confidence.

qualitative_updates.note: BMX Life is the top Top Trending riser (+18), Illegal Bikes is Up-and-Coming #7, Hard Enduro and Backseat Offroad chart, and the new soft-body Crash Engine is Up-and-Coming #3; Realistic Plane Crashing is among the weakest on Most Popular, so the niche is vehicle-led, not plane-led
Find The Anomaly rose 58 places on Up-and-Coming; Peppa's House (Anomaly) is the weakest on Most Popular at 83 days, so durability depends on the theme
Steal with Spider Arms (98% likes) is Up-and-Coming #62 and no steal clone is rising, consistent with the fade
